meta.title: AI Idle Auto-Shutdown (Right Sidebar)
meta.description: Start or stop a monitor of your AI desktop apps (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, WorkBuddy, Cherry Studio, Qoder, Cursor, ...) from the right sidebar: it follows their CPU/IO activity and shuts the machine down after all of them stay idle for the configured minutes, with a dry-run mode and a cancellable countdown.
